name: Pre-commit autofix trigger for bot PRs

on: # actionlint-disable-line zizmor dangerous-triggers
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [master]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  checks: read
  statuses: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  trigger-autofix:
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' || endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]')
    uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger/.github/workflows/autofix.yml@55d00aab
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: read
      statuses: read
      contents: read
